views.name: competition_judges
views.definition:
SELECT ep.id,
    ep.event_id,
    ep.user_id,
    COALESCE(ep.judge_role, 'judge'::competition_judge_role) AS role,
    COALESCE(ep.display_name, (NULLIF(concat_ws(' '::text, ep.first_name, ep.last_name), ''::text))::character varying, u.email) AS display_name,
    ep.is_active,
    ep.has_scored AS has_submitted,
    ep.created_at,
    ep.updated_at
   FROM (event_participants ep
     LEFT JOIN users u ON ((u.id = ep.user_id)))
  WHERE (ep.participant_type = 'COMPETITION_JUDGE'::participant_type);

views.name: contestants
views.definition:

views.name: v_audit_log_with_user
views.definition:
SELECT a.id,
    a.user_id,
    a.action,
    a.entity,
    a.entity_id,
    a.details,
    a.created_at,
    u.email AS user_email,
    u.role AS user_role
   FROM (audit_logs a
     LEFT JOIN users u ON ((u.id = a.user_id)));

views.name: v_competition_active_session
views.definition:
SELECT s.id,
    s.event_id,
    s.status,
    s.current_round_id,
    s.active_contestant_id,
    s.current_contestant_order,
    s.contestant_order,
    s.started_at,
    s.paused_at,
    s.completed_at,
    s.created_at,
    s.updated_at,
    s.current_division_id,
    s.active_contestant_ids,
    s.active_criteria_ids,
    s.arrangement,
    s.rules_version,
    s.access_config,
    s.submission_window,
    s.revision,
    s.lineup_id,
    s.active_slot,
    r.name AS current_round_name,
    c.name AS active_contestant_name,
    c.contestant_number AS active_contestant_number,
    c.photo AS active_contestant_photo
   FROM ((competition_sessions s
     LEFT JOIN competition_rounds r ON ((r.id = s.current_round_id)))
     LEFT JOIN competition_contestants c ON ((c.id = s.active_contestant_id)))
  WHERE (s.status = 'active'::competition_session_status);

views.name: v_election_vote_timeline
views.definition:
SELECT event_id,
    date_trunc('hour'::text, created_at) AS period_hour,
    date_trunc('day'::text, created_at) AS period_day,
    count(*) AS vote_count,
    count(DISTINCT voter_id) AS unique_voters
   FROM election_votes
  GROUP BY event_id, (date_trunc('hour'::text, created_at)), (date_trunc('day'::text, created_at));

views.name: v_event_voters
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    event_id,
    user_id AS voter_id,
        CASE
            WHEN (participant_type = 'ELECTION_VOTER'::participant_type) THEN has_voted
            WHEN (participant_type = 'POLLING_RESPONDENT'::participant_type) THEN has_responded
            ELSE false
        END AS has_voted,
    (participant_type = 'COMPETITION_JUDGE'::participant_type) AS is_judge,
    ((participant_type = 'COMPETITION_JUDGE'::participant_type) AND has_scored) AS has_scored,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    metadata,
    participant_type,
    voting_nonce
   FROM event_participants ep;

views.name: v_legacy_competition_judges
views.definition:
SELECT event_id,
    voter_id AS user_id,
    'judge'::competition_judge_role AS role,
    is_judge AS is_active,
    has_scored AS has_submitted
   FROM event_voters ev
  WHERE (is_judge = true);

views.name: v_poll_question_types
views.definition:
SELECT NULL::uuid AS id,
    NULL::uuid AS organization_id,
    s.key,
    s.label,
    s.description,
    s.answer_format,
    s.config_schema,
    s.ui,
    s.is_active,
    s.sort_order
   FROM system_poll_question_types s
  WHERE (s.is_active = true)
UNION ALL
 SELECT o.id,
    o.organization_id,
    o.key,
    o.label,
    o.description,
    o.answer_format,
    o.config_schema,
    o.ui,
    o.is_active,
    o.sort_order
   FROM poll_question_types o
  WHERE (o.is_active = true);
